description: This file defines the 'Engineering' class within the PhpSpreadsheet calculations namespace, providing various engineering and mathematical functions, constants, and conversions, many of which are deprecated in favor of newer classes and methods.

classes.name: Engineering
classes.description: Provides deprecated and current engineering mathematical constants, functions, and unit conversions, many delegating to specialized classes.

methods.name: BESSELI
methods.description: Calls the BESSELI method from the BesselI class to compute the modified Bessel function of the first kind.

methods.name: BESSELJ
methods.description: Calls the BESSELJ method from the BesselJ class to compute the Bessel function of the first kind.

methods.name: BESSELK
methods.description: Calls the BESSELK method from the BesselK class to compute the modified Bessel function of the second kind.

methods.name: BESSELY
methods.description: Calls the BESSELY method from the BesselY class to compute the Bessel function of the second kind.

methods.name: BINTODEC
methods.description: Converts a binary string to decimal via the ConvertBinary class.

methods.name: BINTOHEX
methods.description: Converts a binary string to hexadecimal via the ConvertBinary class.

methods.name: BINTOOCT
methods.description: Converts a binary string to octal via the ConvertBinary class.

methods.name: DECTOBIN
methods.description: Converts a decimal number to binary via the ConvertDecimal class.

methods.name: DECTOHEX
methods.description: Converts a decimal number to hexadecimal via the ConvertDecimal class.

methods.name: DECTOOCT
methods.description: Converts a decimal number to octal via the ConvertDecimal class.

methods.name: HEXTOBIN
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string to binary via the ConvertHex class.

methods.name: HEXTODEC
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string to decimal via the ConvertHex class.

methods.name: HEXTOOCT
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string to octal via the ConvertHex class.

methods.name: OCTTOBIN
methods.description: Converts an octal string to binary via the ConvertOctal class.

methods.name: OCTTODEC
methods.description: Converts an octal string to decimal via the ConvertOctal class.

methods.name: OCTTOHEX
methods.description: Converts an octal string to hexadecimal via the ConvertOctal class.

methods.name: COMPLEX
methods.description: Creates a complex number string from real and imaginary parts via the Complex class.

methods.name: IMAGINARY
methods.description: Extracts the imaginary part of a complex number using the Complex class.

methods.name: IMREAL
methods.description: Extracts the real part of a complex number using the Complex class.

methods.name: IMABS
methods.description: Calculates the magnitude of a complex number via the ComplexFunctions class.

methods.name: IMARGUMENT
methods.description: Calculates the argument (angle) of a complex number via the ComplexFunctions class.

methods.name: IMCONJUGATE
methods.description: Calculates the conjugate of a complex number via the ComplexFunctions class.

methods.name: IMCOS
methods.description: Computes the cosine of a complex number via the ComplexFunctions class.

methods.name: IMCOSH
methods.description: Computes the hyperbolic cosine of a complex number via the ComplexFunctions class.

methods.name: IMCOT
methods.description: Computes the cotangent of a complex number via the ComplexFunctions class.

methods.name: IMCSC
methods.description: Computes the cosecant of a complex number via the ComplexFunctions class.

methods.name: IMCSCH
methods.description: Computes the hyperbolic cosecant of a complex number via the ComplexFunctions class.

methods.name: IMSIN
methods.description: Calculates the sine of a complex number via the ComplexFunctions class.

methods.name: IMSINH
methods.description: Calculates the hyperbolic sine of a complex number via the ComplexFunctions class.

methods.name: IMSEC
methods.description: Calculates the secant of a complex number via the ComplexFunctions class.

methods.name: IMSECH
methods.description: Calculates the hyperbolic secant of a complex number via the ComplexFunctions class.

methods.name: IMTAN
methods.description: Calculates the tangent of a complex number via the ComplexFunctions class.

methods.name: IMSQRT
methods.description: Calculates the square root of a complex number via the ComplexFunctions class.

methods.name: IMLN
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm of a complex number via the ComplexFunctions class.

methods.name: IMLOG10
methods.description: Calculates the base-10 logarithm of a complex number via the ComplexFunctions class.

methods.name: IMLOG2
methods.description: Calculates the base-2 logarithm of a complex number via the ComplexFunctions class.

methods.name: IMEXP
methods.description: Calculates the exponential of a complex number via the ComplexFunctions class.

methods.name: IMPOWER
methods.description: Raises a complex number to a power via the ComplexFunctions class.

methods.name: IMDIV
methods.description: Divides two complex numbers via the ComplexOperations class.

methods.name: IMSUB
methods.description: Subtracts two complex numbers via the ComplexOperations class.

methods.name: IMSUM
methods.description: Sums multiple complex numbers via the ComplexOperations class.

methods.name: IMPRODUCT
methods.description: Calculates the product of multiple complex numbers via the ComplexOperations class.

methods.name: DELTA
methods.description: Implements the Kronecker delta function via the Compare class.

methods.name: GESTEP
methods.description: Returns 1 if number >= step, otherwise 0, via the Compare class.

methods.name: BITAND
methods.description: Performs bitwise AND of two integers via the BitWise class.

methods.name: BITOR
methods.description: Performs bitwise OR of two integers via the BitWise class.

methods.name: BITXOR
methods.description: Performs bitwise XOR of two integers via the BitWise class.

methods.name: BITLSHIFT
methods.description: Shifts an integer left by specified bits via the BitWise class.

methods.name: BITRSHIFT
methods.description: Shifts an integer right by specified bits via the BitWise class.

methods.name: ERF
methods.description: Calculates the error function via the Erf class.

methods.name: ERFPRECISE
methods.description: Calculates the error function with a different algorithm via the Erf class.

methods.name: ERFC
methods.description: Calculates the complementary error function via the ErfC class.

methods.name: getConversionGroups
methods.description: Returns list of conversion categories for UOM conversions via the ConvertUOM class.

methods.name: getConversionGroupUnits
methods.description: Returns units for a conversion category via the ConvertUOM class.

methods.name: getConversionGroupUnitDetails
methods.description: Returns details of units within a category via the ConvertUOM class.

methods.name: getConversionMultipliers
methods.description: Returns measurement prefixes for UOM conversions via the ConvertUOM class.

methods.name: getBinaryConversionMultipliers
methods.description: Returns binary measurement prefixes for UOM conversions via the ConvertUOM class.

methods.name: CONVERTUOM
methods.description: Converts units of measure via the ConvertUOM class.
